constraint_handling.description: Token-based state retention with explicit prioritization rules. When the state approaches 7,500–8,000 tokens, prioritize conversation relevance, inference, and contextual compression to make hard choices about what to discard or compress.

state_design.approach: Compact, contextually relevant state with automatic cleanup via token-based thresholds and explicit prioritization.

prioritization_criteria.description: Retain only the most recent or contextually critical parts of the conversation.
Discard data if it can be reconstructed or derived from other stored information.

state_design.feedback_loop: Reflect on utility of discarded data after each cycle to refine prioritization criteria.
state_design.compression_analogy: State as a lossy compression artifact: retain only the ‘compressed’ information that preserves utility.
